lines.text: Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah and told them they had rejected God by asking for a king.
The tribe of Benjamin was selected, then the clan of Matri, and finally Saul son of Kish.
The LORD said Saul had hidden himself among the baggage, so they ran and brought him, and he stood a head taller.
Samuel explained the rights of kingship, wrote them on a scroll, and laid it up at Rachel's tomb.
Saul went home to Gibeah, but some worthless men said, "Why did this man hide from us?"
